name: AA Visitor Counter Widget
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
Displays a visitor counter on your site by country. Easy setup via widget. Get real-time insights into your global audience.

Features

  • Display visitor count by country
  • Real-time visitor tracking
  • Lightweight and optimized for performance
  • Easy-to-install widget – no coding needed
  • Compatible with most WordPress themes
  • Great for blogs, business websites, and personal portfolios

How to use it

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Appearance → Widgets
  3. Drag and drop AA Visitor Counter Widget into your sidebar or footer
  4. Save the widget settings
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/aa-visitor-counter directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Place the widget in your desired widget area
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Security Update
  • Basic visitor tracking by country
  • Widget display functionality
  • Admin statistics page
